author: marcfeuermann
body:
PTHR22811 is already annotated with GO:0006888 endoplasmic reticulum to Golgi vesicle-mediated transport
I created and propagated  MF GO:0140312 cargo adaptor activity (contributes to)
The complex term, GO:7770070 p24 cargo receptor complex, is too recent and not available yet for PAINTing. This will have to wait until the next PAINT update which can take a few months.
Best regards,
Marc.
